rows.ARS:
Pink blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Mind Games ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Colin Dickson (1956-....) (United Kingdom, before 2010).
Introduced in New Zealand by Bambina Rose NZ Ltd,.
Introduced in United Kingdom by Dickson Nurseries Ltd. / Dickson Roses in 2012 as 'Mind Games'.
Introduced in Australia by Treloar Roses in 2019 as 'Mind Games'.
rows.Bloom: Pink and white, stripes. Mild fragrance. Semi-double (9-16 petals), in large clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 2' (up to 60cm). Width: up to 2' (up to 60cm).
rows.Notes: Parentage: Vanilla Twist x Night Sky according to Member comments
